arxiv-2408-00437.creator: Seline J.S. de Rooij, Frederiek Wesel, Borbála Hunyadi
arxiv-2408-00437.description: Abstract Recent developments in wearable devices have made accurate and efficient seizure detection more important than ever. arxiv-2504-03918.title: Analysis of Uncertainty in Procedural Maps in Slay the Spire
arxiv-2504-03918.creator: Mahsa Bazzaz, Seth Cooper
arxiv-2504-03918.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mahsa Bazzaz, Seth Cooper. This work investigates the role of uncertainty in Slay the Spire using an information-theoretic framework. Focusing on the entropy of game paths (which are based on procedurally-generated maps) we analyze how randomness influences player decision-making and success. By examining a dataset of 20,000 game runs, we quantify the entropy of paths taken by players and relate it with their outcomes and skill levels. The results show that victorious runs are associated with higher normalized entropy, suggesting more risk-taking.

arxiv-2509-16261.title: RaFD: Flow-Guided Radar Detection for Robust Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2509-16261.creator: Shuocheng Yang, Zikun Xu, Jiahao Wang, Shahid Nawaz, Jianqiang Wang, Shaobing Xu
arxiv-2509-16261.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shuocheng Yang, Zikun Xu, Jiahao Wang, Shahid Nawaz, Jianqiang Wang, Shaobing Xu. Radar has shown strong potential for robust perception in autonomous driving; however, raw radar images are frequently degraded by noise and “ghost” artifacts, making object detection based solely on semantic features highly challenging. To address this limitation, we introduce RaFD , a radar-based object detection framework that estimates inter-frame bird’s-eye-view (BEV) flow and leverages the resulting geometric cues to enhance detection accuracy.

arxiv-2512-01795.title: The Hidden Cost of Straight Lines: Quantifying Misallocation Risk in Voronoi-Based Service Area Models
arxiv-2512-01795.creator: JA Torrecilla Pinero, JM Ceballos Martinez, A Cuartero Saez, P Plaza Caballero, A Cruces Lopez
arxiv-2512-01795.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by JA Torrecilla Pinero, JM Ceballos Martinez, A Cuartero Saez, P Plaza Caballero, A Cruces Lopez. Voronoi tessellations are a standard tool in spatial planning for assigning service areas based on Euclidean proximity. This approach underpins key regulatory frameworks, such as the proximity principle in waste management [ 34 , 46 ] . However, in regions with complex topography or sparse infrastructure, Euclidean distance is a poor proxy for functional accessibility, leading to service area misallocations that undermine cost-efficiency and equity.

pmc-10682073.description: Macrophages are highly heterogeneous immune cells with a role in maintaining tissue homeostasis, especially in activating the defense response to bacterial infection. pmc-11647408.creator: Yoon-Been Park, Chiwoong Lim, Byeonghwi Lim, Jun-Mo Kim
pmc-11647408.description: The mechanism of estrous cycles of pigs should be explored because their reproductive traits are useful for manipulating productivity and solving problems such as infertility. pmc-11680643.title: A municipality-specific analysis to investigate persistent increased incidence rates of childhood leukaemia near the nuclear power plant of Krümmel in Germany
pmc-11680643.creator: Emilio Gianicolo, Antonello Russo, Rossana Di Staso, Cécile M Ronckers, Irene Schmidtmann, Daniel Wollschläger, Maria Blettner
pmc-11680643.description: Increased incidence rates for childhood leukaemia have been reported in municipalities close to the nuclear power plant (NPP) Krümmel (Geesthacht, Germany). Methodological challenges arise when analysing this association at ecological level. They include the use of an appropriate reference population, unstable estimates of standardised incidence ratios (SIRs), and the potential role of prevailing winds.

pmc-13216101.creator: Carlos Noriega, Cryssia Romão, Rafael Aquino, Sury Monteiro, Bruna Moraes, Rodrigo Brito, Carmen Medeiros, Marcelo Rollnic, Moacyr Araujo

pmc-13384246.title: Diagnostic potential of B‐cell translocation gene 2 in IgA nephropathy: Insights from molecular mechanisms
pmc-13384246.creator: Min Kou, Mo Dan, Juan Cheng, Sheng Ge, Ruimin Ren
pmc-13384246.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IgA nephropathy (IgAN) is a prevalent glomerular disease characterized by IgA deposition, chronic inflammation, and fibrosis, leading to end‐stage renal disease. This study explored B‐cell translocation gene 2 (BTG2) as a biomarker and treatment target for IgAN progression. Through integrated expression datasets and functional analyses, BTG2 emerged as a key gene with downregulation in renal tissues of IgAN patients, showing high diagnostic accuracy. BTG2 influenced the immune microenvironment by modulating T follicular helper cells and M0 macrophages.

pmc-13594375.title: Dynamic imbalance of mitochondria-associated ER membranes in cardiovascular disease: mechanisms, context dependence and therapeutic potential
pmc-13594375.creator: Yuhong Tang, Dezhao Liu, Beibei Luo, Feng Huang
pmc-13594375.description: Mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes (MAMs) are dynamic contact sites that coordinate structural and functional communication between the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and mitochondria. By organizing tethering complexes, calcium channels, lipid-transfer machinery, and stress-responsive signaling modules, MAMs regulate Ca2+ homeostasis, lipid metabolism, mitochondrial dynamics, mitophagy, oxidative stress, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and cell fate determination.
